overview: The Medford City Council granted special permits and licenses for an automotive shop and approved a home rule petition to increase wine and malt liquor licenses. The council also addressed aircraft noise from Logan Airport, traffic and school zone safety, street sweeping policies, parking kiosk holiday fees, and requested a legal opinion on local control following the passage of Question 4 legalizing recreational marijuana.

items.title: Dom's Motor Service Special Permit and Class 4 License
items.summary: Approved a special permit and Class 4 automotive repair license for Dom's Motor Service to relocate to 83 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Massport CAC Representation and Logan Airport Noise
items.summary: The council discussed aircraft noise impacts and recommended appointing a council member or alternate to the Massport Community Advisory Committee to represent the city at upcoming FAA and Massport meetings.

items.title: Central Avenue Centerline Repainting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Department of Public Works repaint the yellow centerline on Central Avenue.

items.title: School Drop-Off Safety and Traffic Patterns
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting school and police officials review drop-off procedures at Roberts Elementary School and expanded the review citywide with School Committee involvement.

items.title: Eastern Bus Speeding Reminders
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting police and school officials contact Eastern Bus regarding reports of speeding, unoccupied buses.

items.title: MBTA Bus Speeding, Citywide Speed Limit, and Traffic Enforcement
items.summary: Approved a resolution to address MBTA bus speeding on South Street, amended to ask the Traffic Commission to study a citywide 25 mph speed limit and request police staffing numbers.

items.title: Neighborhood Reverse 911 Notifications
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the police department to utilize reverse 911 calls for localized neighborhood crime and safety alerts.

items.title: Essex and High Streets Crosswalk Safety
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting pedestrian crossing signs at Essex and High Streets and asking the Traffic Commission to evaluate whether to relocate or remove the crosswalk.

items.title: Legal Opinion on Marijuana Zoning and Licensing After Question 4
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a legal opinion from the city solicitor regarding local zoning and licensing authority over medical and recreational marijuana facilities following the passage of Question 4.

items.title: Home Rule Petition for Wine and Malt Beverage Licenses
items.summary: Rescinded a prior committee referral and approved a home rule petition seeking state authorization to increase available wine and malt beverage licenses in Medford from 25 to 40.

items.title: Route 16 Truck Route Rerouting Study
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the Traffic Commission to examine allowing trucks and buses to turn right from Winthrop Street onto Route 16 to access Interstate 93.

items.title: Fall Street Sweeping Policy and Signage
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update on fall street sweeping enforcement and ticketing policies, amended to request accurate dates on electronic city billboards.

items.title: Property Expenditure Update
items.summary: Tabled a resolution requesting an update on approved municipal property expenditures.

items.title: Citizen Petition on Bicycle Safety and Roadway Usage
items.summary: Placed on file a citizen petition raising safety concerns about bicycles sharing narrow roadways with motor vehicles.

items.title: Grove Street Crosswalk Status Request
items.summary: Approved a request for a status update on painting a crosswalk at Grove Street and Business Way.

items.title: Condolences for Rita Curtin and Holiday Parking Kiosk Billing
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for longtime resident Rita Curtin and approved a resolution requesting Park Medford refund motorists charged by parking kiosks on Veterans Day.
